svg.title: Learning machinery built but idle
svg.desc: Five components exist in code but do not change behaviour: the skill_adapter optimizer, the learned threshold statistic, the 9D loss and gradient backprop modules, the learning daemon, and kb learn / guidance.

svg.text: Code that exists and is tested — none of it changes a decision today.
